search_objective: Identify authoritative sources reporting West Nile virus cases, deaths, hospitalizations, and surveillance data for California during August 2024 (2024-08-01 to 2024-08-31), covering all target fields: confirmed/probable/suspected/unspecified cases, deaths, hospitalizations, subnational and local locations, and date reported.
search_reasoning: West Nile virus in California is primarily tracked by the California Department of Public Health (CDPH) and county-level health departments, which publish weekly or cumulative WNV surveillance summaries during the transmission season (typically June–October). The CDC ArboNET system also aggregates state-reported WNV data. August is peak WNV season in California, so official agency surveillance pages and weekly reports are the highest-yield sources. The upstream planned queries use overly rigid quoted phrase constructions (e.g., "WNV California August 2024") that may suppress relevant results; this iteration replaces them with more natural, flexible query formulations targeting the specific agencies and data systems known to report California WNV. The 4-query limit per iteration requires prioritizing: (1) CDPH official WNV surveillance page, (2) CDC ArboNET/WNV data, (3) county-level health department reports for high-burden California counties (e.g., Los Angeles, Sacramento, Kern, Fresno), and (4) news/media reports that may cite official figures for August 2024. Literature and structured database queries are deferred to iteration 2 if needed, as peer-reviewed publications for August 2024 events are unlikely to exist yet. Language is English only; no localization needed for California.

query_batch.query: California West Nile virus cases 2024 CDPH surveillance weekly report August
query_batch.query_rationale: Directly targets the California Department of Public Health (CDPH) WNV surveillance reporting page, which publishes weekly cumulative case counts, deaths, and county-level breakdowns during the transmission season. August 2024 data would appear in weekly updates published during or shortly after that month. This is the single highest-yield source for all target fields.
query_batch.expected_source_type_or_evidence: CDPH West Nile virus surveillance page or weekly activity report with cumulative and weekly case counts by county
query_batch.expected_trust_signal: cdph.ca.gov domain; official state public health agency; cites ArboNET or state lab-confirmed data

query_batch.query: CDC West Nile virus 2024 California cases deaths ArboNET statistics
query_batch.query_rationale: Targets CDC's ArboNET-based WNV surveillance data for 2024, which aggregates state-reported figures including California. CDC publishes cumulative national and state-level WNV case counts, neuroinvasive vs. non-neuroinvasive breakdowns, and deaths. This provides cross-validation against CDPH figures and may include data through August 2024.
query_batch.expected_source_type_or_evidence: CDC WNV disease cases and deaths reported to CDC by state, 2024 provisional data table
query_batch.expected_trust_signal: cdc.gov domain; federal public health authority; ArboNET surveillance system

query_batch.query_rationale: Targets county-level public health department reports for California counties with historically high WNV burden (Los Angeles, Sacramento, Kern, Fresno, Riverside, San Bernardino). The broader query without rigid quoting increases recall across multiple county agency sites.

query_batch.expected_trust_signal: County .gov or .ca.gov domain; official county health officer or epidemiologist attribution

A second iteration targeting the specific August 2024 Arbobulletin numbers, the CDC 2024 historical WNV data table, and county-level health department August 2024 reports is warranted to fill these gaps before the iteration limit is reached.
